question: Can you provide a breakdown of how many times each product was viewed, how many times they were added to the shopping cart, and how many times they were left in the cart without being purchased? Also, give me the count of actual purchases for each product. Ensure that products with a page id in (1, 2, 12, 13) are filtered out.
sql:
SELECT 
    COALESCE(ph.product_id, 0) AS product_id,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 1 THEN 1 END) AS views,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 2 THEN 1 END) AS added_to_cart,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN se.event_type = 3 THEN 1 END) AS purchases
FROM shopping_cart_events se
JOIN shopping_cart_page_hierarchy ph ON se.page_id = ph.page_id
WHERE se.page_id NOT IN (1, 2, 12, 13)
GROUP BY ph.product_id
ORDER BY product_id
